messages:
sre-oncall: Holding today's 09:00 UTC release slot. Were seeing a cross-region KV cache inconsistency impacting EU edge (incident 64321). Aborting canary rollout for now. :rotating_light:
deploy-bot: Release slot 2026-03-21T09:00 UTC held by sre-oncall — canary aborted, jobs cancelled. Notifying owners.
eng-release: Thanks — any ETA on root cause?
kevin: Observed ~30s divergence in prefix TTLs between eu-west and eu-central caches, causing stale reads. Tracing now.
maria: If reads can return stale embeddings it could break rerank logic. We should pin the previous model/hash for traffic until resolved.
product-ops: Agreed — pause the release notes publish and hold customer-facing comms until confirmed.
ops-lead: Propose we revert EU zones to pinned v2026-03-19-2, validate, then requeue a staggered canary after cache fix. Thoughts?
alice: Revert sounds safest. Small hotfix riskier unless cache invalidation guaranteed.
kevin: I'll run rollback: kubectl -n orbit rollout undo deploy/edge-inference --to-revision=42, then trigger cache flush: 
```
kubectl -n orbit exec -it cache-flusher -- /bin/sh -c "./flush-prefixes --regions=eu-*"
```
pm-anna: Who owns the rollback? Need a checklist for releasebot so unhold/reschedule requires manual approval.
sre-oncall: Kevin takes rollback, ops-lead coordinates smoke tests. I'll keep incident channel open and post updates.
eng-release: Deploy-bot, after rollback, do NOT auto-resume queued releases — require manual /approve-resume from sre-oncall.
deploy-bot: Acknowledged. Auto-resume disabled until manual approval.
product-ops: Timeline: rollback now, 30m smoke tests, if green requeue staggered rollout at +2h with per-zone gating. If failing, reschedule to tomorrow morning and escalate.
kevin: Started rollback. ETA ~10m for rollout-undo.
sre-oncall: Also add to release notes draft: "Release delayed due to cache divergence in EU edge; rescheduling pending validation." Full technical summary after RCA.
alice: Adding short ops note to release doc and #customers-notify draft.
eng-release: Confirmed: do not merge release notes or run notify workflow until I mark it "safe".
product-ops: I'll hold blog/email. pm-anna will update stakeholders.
pm-anna: Noted — I'll ping legal/comms once validation passes.
sre-oncall: Update at +15m or sooner if anything blocks. :white_check_mark:
